title: Run Rust projects as a fourth practice language (rustc in the shared runner image)
description:
Feature: Rust practice runs
  Scenario: Compile and run a Rust program with stdin
    Given a Rust project that reads a name and greets it
    When the project is run
    Then the output is the greeting
  Scenario: A panic is reported as a runtime error with exit code 101
  Scenario: A compile error shows file and line

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged (PR #31): rustc 1.99 in the shared runner image, 166 Linux scenarios incl. hostile cases, overflow checks on. Deploy and live verification pending.

right_now_summary: Rust support is merged into the runner image; deployment and live checks are still pending.
